contributions.detail: Schedule A (p2) carries the single typed word 'N/A' in the row area and no transactions. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $0' and 'Total Contributions Received $ 0'; Summary p4 Box B (This Period) = 0 and Box C (Year-to-Date) = 0. The two scopes coincide at zero, so scope recorded cumulative. The CFD form prints no separate <=$50 aggregate line, so the le50 keys are null.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B (p3) carries the single typed word 'N/A' and no transactions. Printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 0' and 'Total Expenditures Made $ 0'; Summary p4 Box D = 0, Box E = 0. Scopes coincide at zero.

gates.page_subtotal: p2: 0 rows sum 0.00 = printed Subtotal $0 = printed Total $0. p3: 0 rows sum 0.00 = printed Subtotal $ 0 = printed Total $ 0. Both gate exactly.
gates.row_count: Born-digital CFD; the schedule area is UNRULED below the header (no writing lines), so rowbands.py has no grid to score. Counted by ink: p2 one non-transaction token 'N/A', p3 one non-transaction token 'N/A' - zero inked transaction rows on either side, zero rows emitted.
gates.geometry_proof: No rows emitted, so no row geometry to prove. Both schedule row areas were rendered full-page at 200 dpi and are empty apart from the 'N/A' tokens.
gates.balance_chain: Box A -1655.65 + Box B 0 = Box F -1655.65 (closes); Box F -1655.65 - Box D 0 = Balance at Close -1655.65 (closes). Chain closes exactly. The negative opening balance is the filer's own figure, carried verbatim.

escalation_note: Born-digital vector PDF; every figure renders crisply at 200 dpi and is corroborated by the embedded text layer. No bistable glyphs, so no crop escalation was warranted.
notes: index.csv calls the office 'Clerk/Auditor'; the form's own Office line reads 'County Clerk' - same office, but the form's wording governs. index.csv/chunk date is 2026-06-16 (the county's June-16 posting batch); the form's own 'Date of Report' and signature date are 06-09-2026 - the DOCUMENT date is 2026-06-09. PAGE ORDER differs from the addendum's description of this family: p1 is the candidate/affirmation cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, and the lettered A-F Summary Page is p4 (not p1). The candidate's home street address, phone and email are printed in the clear on p1 and were discarded at read time. 'N/A' is a nil mark, not a zero glyph, so it produces no row; the printed schedule totals '0' are real numerals and are recorded as anchors.
